messages:
Lena (Billing): FYI Helix Labs (acct HLX-204) payment failed. They tried split payments across two cards then a wire which returned 'invalid_account'. Need triage.

billing-bot: [event] payment.attempt id=pay_9XyZ amount=20400 currency=usd status=failed reason=invalid_account gateway=wire ts=2023468902

Priya (Support): Procurement walked through sequence: card A auth $12,240 -> card B auth $8,160 -> fraud filter triggered 3DS challenge that wasn't completed. Then they attempted wire using an old IBAN and it returned. They want clear next steps.

Omar (Finance): Plan: 1) cancel stale auths to release holds, 2) send corrected signed wire PDF with unique ref, 3) require W-9 before wire (compliance), 4) give temporary access grace while we collect proof of payment.

Lena (Billing): Cancelled auths: `stripe.auth.cancel([auth_12A,auth_34B])` -> ok. Holds released. Wire return code RTN42 logged.

billing-bot: [event] authorizations.cancelled ids=[auth_12A,auth_34B] ts=2023468950

Priya (Support): Procurement can re-initiate wire but needs W-9 and corrected IBAN. I sent secure upload link.

Tariq (Sales): Approve 5 business days grace if they provide PO + proof of upcoming wire. Keep product access active.

Legal-bot: [reminder] HLX-204: W-9 required for domestic wire > $10k. Upload: https://secure.redwood/w9-upload

Omar (Finance): I'll attach wire PDF with ref REF-HLX204-2023 and mark invoice INV-6021 manual_collect_inprogress.

Lena (Billing): Invoice flags set: [manual_collect_inprogress, sales_grace_5d]. Note: "Do not suspend until 5 business days unless non-payment confirmed."

billing-bot: [event] invoice.updated id=INV-6021 flags=[manual_collect_inprogress,sales_grace_5d] ts=2023469001

Priya (Support): Follow-up asks procurement to upload W-9, confirm wire with reference REF-HLX204-2023, and attach sender bank details. Suggested card retry only if they can complete 3DS.

Helix Procurement (via Priya): Will upload W-9 today and re-initiate wire tomorrow morning. Had wrong IBAN 5 thanks for PDF.

Omar (Finance): Recap: Lena cancelled auths, I sent wire PDF/compliance link, Sales approved grace, Support to monitor proof of payment.

Lena (Billing): I'll set a 72h monitor and create follow-up if no proof.

Priya (Support): Setting reminders: +24h (W-9), +48h (wire init), +72h (clear).

Tariq (Sales): If problems continue, offer ACH with verification window. Keep me posted.

Lena (Billing): Thanks all. Posting updates here when W-9/proof arrive. :v:
